CustomField.description: Fixed call-offer / availability blurb appended to every drafted reply (with the owner signature and any documentation links) after generation. There is no calendar integration and a case owner's real free/busy is not in Salesforce, so state stable hours here. Edit without a code deploy. Blank falls back to the class default (SupportDraftingService.DEFAULT_CALL_OFFER).
